A '''species''' of primitive [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] scavenger/hunters evolved on the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Adner]]. Members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] were semi-social and lived in tribes ranging in size from five to twenty individuals. The species eventually evolved into the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Adnerem]] species, who maintained their precursors species' social units, which became known as [[Steris|steri]].<ref name="AE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The precursor species to the Adnerem was first mentioned in [[1996]], when author [[Timothy S. O'Brien]] mentioned them in an entry in his article "[[Alien Encounters (article series)|Alien Encounters]]" as part of the Adnerem section, published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 11]], published by [[West End Games]]. The article was republished in a reduced form, still mentioning the precursor species, in the book ''[[Alien Encounters]]'' in [[1998]], a collection of alien species compiled by [[Paul Sudlow]].
